derivation: contract C2 `hreflang_self_missing`: A has one hreflang alternate (en to B) and does not list its own url; A2 emits it once for the page. B returns en to A, lists itself and resolves canonical to self.

files.a.html:
<!doctype html>
<html><head>
<link rel="canonical" href="https://alpha.example/a">
<link rel="alternate" hreflang="en" href="https://beta.example/b">
</head><body></body></html>
files.b.html:
<!doctype html>
<html><head>
<link rel="canonical" href="https://beta.example/b">
<link rel="alternate" hreflang="en" href="https://beta.example/b">
<link rel="alternate" hreflang="en" href="https://alpha.example/a">
</head><body></body></html>

name: self-missing-pair
